cards.imgPrompt: Flat vector illustration, no people, no faces, no text. A single office desk at night seen from a low three-quarter angle: one glowing monitor showing a blank document, an empty swivel chair pushed back, a cold paper coffee cup, dark window behind with a few lit windows of another building. Muted desaturated palette: charcoal #252c28, warm cream #fdf6ea, one terracotta accent #d4703c. Soft flat shapes, no gradients on objects, no glow, no lens flare, no neon. Portrait composition with empty space in the lower third.
